paper.review_title: Routing by Reaching: Composition of Pre-trained GFlowNets for Multi-Objective Generation
paper.arxiv_v1_title: Training-free Composition of Pre-trained GFlowNets for Multi-Objective Generation

interpretation: The recorded evidence verifies finite exact and scoped empirical contracts, falsifies the exact printed C2 point, and blocks C3/C4 because required molecule artifacts are absent.

claims.paper_claim: Reaching-weighted composition recovers the exact linearly scalarized HyperGrid target.
production_path: Enumerate the 32x32 HyperGrid and 128 simplex preferences for each k in 2..5.
Evaluate reaching-weighted mixtures and the exact target distribution.
Write raw summaries and independently recompute flow and terminal-distribution residuals.
Run omission, partition-normalization, and wrong-beta mutations; require each control to fail.
claims.limitations: This is a finite exact regression and does not by itself prove the universal theorem.

claims.paper_claim: The neural HyperGrid comparison attains the printed ours value of 0.003 while outperforming the baselines.
production_path: Train or retain the source-faithful 32x32 neural architecture for 48 models across three seeds.
Evaluate 128 preferences for each objective count k in 2..5 over all 1,024 terminal states.
Aggregate seed means and two-sided 95% t intervals for ours, MOGFN, HN-GFN, and the no-reaching ablation.
Require qualitative ordering in every seed/k cell and test whether the exact printed 0.003 lies below every ours interval.
claims.limitations: The exact printed point is not supported by the archived run; this does not falsify the qualitative advantage or every rounded interpretation of the table.

claims.paper_claim: QM9 GAP-SA reaches 0.876 for the proposed composition versus MOGFN 0.816 and HN-GFN 0.805.
production_path: Check the released tree for the QM9 data, GAP scorer, ingredient checkpoints, and MOGFN/HN-GFN comparator checkpoints.
Compare the discovered materials with the exact beta=32, ten-preference, 128-candidate contract.
Return BLOCKED when required artifacts are absent; do not substitute a proxy scorer or toy run.
claims.limitations: A faithful C3 result requires the missing checkpoints and comparator surfaces.

claims.paper_claim: Logical molecule composition gives a 40-70x speedup with comparable or better accuracy.
production_path: Check for the classifier-guidance implementation, required checkpoints, timing benchmark, target-bin sampler, and comparator imports.
Compare released SA/QED thresholds with the arXiv v1 contract.
Return BLOCKED when the timing or comparator surface is absent or thresholds drift; do not invent a speedup.
claims.limitations: A faithful C4 result requires the missing classifier-guidance and timing/comparator materials.

claims.paper_claim: The reaching probability term is responsible for the neural composition improvement.
production_path: Reuse the same trained ingredients, seeds, preferences, and terminal evaluations as C2.
Remove only u_i(s), the reaching probability term, from the mixer.
Compare the paired no-reaching and reaching scores in all 12 seed/k cells.
Require at least 0.05 paired degradation and retain the removed-reaching mutation as a negative control.
claims.limitations: The verdict is scoped to the archived three-seed HyperGrid contract.

claims.paper_claim: For nonlinear composition, distortion is closer to constant in high-G regions.
production_path: Enumerate G(x), u_M(x), N_M(x), delta(x)=u_M(x)/N_M(x), induced mass, target mass, and L1 contribution.
Run the two primary nonlinear operators over three seeds for six primary rows.
Recompute high-G versus bottom-half variance, median deviation, RMSE, and error-share comparisons with a stdlib checker.
Shuffle N_M as a negative control and keep the broader 36-row appendix descriptive because it contains five reversals.
claims.limitations: The positive verdict is restricted to the six primary rows; the broader appendix is not used to generalize it.
